title: stats widget: Getting stats from DerivedHelper

comments.body: Hi @timkelty thanks for pushing the API :) As of now we haven't done much work combining instantsearch.js and the derived helpers. The derived helpers generate their own events that instantsearch don't listen to. The easiest way to do what you want is to listen directly to the result event of the derived and update your UI accordingly without using a widget. How does that sound?

@bobylito sounds good, that's what I figured. Would be a nice addition in the future, though!

I figured this wouldn't "just work", but I wondered if there was a way I could do what I was, and listen for the `DerivedHelper.result` and trigger some kind of `refresh()` on the stats widget specifically.
What do you mean by `refresh()`? Trigger a new search, only for the derived helper?
Sorry, no - I mean just trigger the update the stats widget component to update, from the `.result` event of the DerivedHelper
I am sorry, I'm still not sure what it would imply? Is it a refresh of the values of the stats widget?

I guess I was thinking if I could trigger the stats widget could re-render _after_ I got my derived result, then `locationsHelper.lastResults` would be populated by then (similar to how I can see the result if I `console.log`).

...then again, just spitballing.
